Author: Pankaj Purohit
Bench: Pankaj Purohit
 
 Office Notes, reports,
Sl. orders or proceedings or
 Date 
No directions and Registrar's
 order with Signatures
 Wpcrl No.1328 of 2024
 Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
None present for petitioner.
2.
Mr. Vipul Painuli, learned Brief Holder for the State of Uttarakhand/respondent Nos.1 and 2.
3. Mr. Manoj Joshi, learned counsel for respondent No.3, appeared through video conferencing.

4. By means of the present criminal writ petition, petitioner has challenged the Fir No.126 of 2024
dated 19.05.2024, for the offence punishable under Section 420 of I.P.C., registered with P.S.
Lalkuan, District Nainital.
5.

It is submitted by learned State Counsel that after investigation, charge-sheet has been submitted
against the petitioner on 25.12.2024, therefore, nothing remains to be decided in this writ petition
and it has become infructuous.
6.  In view of the statement made by learned State Counsel, the present criminal writ petition is dismissed as infructuous.
However, it is open to petitioner to challenge the charge-sheet in appropriate proceedings, before the appropriate forum.
